baseline.effects: Update transform; capture/release pointer; manual mode suppresses automatic fit.

baseline.effects: Advance navigation revision, switch relevant view and defer focus/scroll.

Valid target selects relevant view/route/node and defers scrolling/focus under revision guard; no history write. Conditional valid-rendered-Atlas client source only. No build/source-freshness, real browser geometry/focus/pointer/download/print or whole-machine observation. Invalid hashes are remembered but are not a universal revision invalidation guarantee.
